annotations.title: DoD OCONUS / INDOPACOM Deployment, SOFA, Defense Base Act (DBA) & SPOT Compliance

description: Evaluate Pacific/OCONUS defense IT solicitations for Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA) TESA/TDY accreditation, FAR 52.228-3 Defense Base Act (DBA) insurance wraps, DFARS 252.225-7040 SPOT synchronization, and COLA/Post Allowance rate structures. Returns a strictly validated `OconusSofaDbaResponse` JSON object containing `oconus_theater_deployment_overview`, `sofa_host_nation_accreditation_matrix`, `dba_insurance_and_dssr_allowance_model`, and `spot_loa_and_crc_deployment_checklist` grounded in FAR 52.228-3 (42 U.S.C. §§ 1651–1654 Defense Base Act), DFARS 252.225-7040 / 252.225-7995 (SPOT LOA), & DSSR Chapters 130/220/650. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive GovCon compliance and capture analysis call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key or X-SignalTender-Key; `oconus_pws_and_theater_clauses_text` accepts 15 to 45,000 characters, while `target_combatant_command_and_host_nations` and `dba_and_dssr_allowance_assumptions` calibrate the regulatory regime and threshold assumptions). Use this tool when executing DoD OCONUS / INDOPACOM Deployment, SOFA, Defense Base Act (DBA) & SPOT Compliance workflows; use `scan_far_dfars_clauses` instead for general FAR/DFARS clause flow-down audits, or `generate_compliance_matrix` for general Section L/M 'shall' requirement extraction.

dba_and_dssr_allowance_assumptions.default: FAR 52.228-3 Defense Base Act (DBA) Insurance + DSSR Living Quarters Allowance (LQA), Post Allowance (COLA), & Danger Pay
dba_and_dssr_allowance_assumptions.description: Operational context, threshold parameters, or compliance posture assumptions (defaults to 'FAR 52.228-3 Defense Base Act (DBA) Insurance + DSSR Living Quarters Allowance (LQA), Post Allowance (COLA), & Danger Pay').

oconus_pws_and_theater_clauses_text.description: Primary solicitation text, clause excerpts, deliverable schedule, or technical/financial context for DoD OCONUS / INDOPACOM Deployment, SOFA, Defense Base Act (DBA) & SPOT Compliance (15 to 45,000 characters).

target_combatant_command_and_host_nation.description: Target regulatory regime, statutory authority, or evaluation framework (defaults to 'USINDOPACOM_USFJ_Japan_USFK_Korea_Guam_And_USEUCOM_Germany_DOCPER_TESA').

name: generate_oconus_sofa_defense_logistics

dba_insurance_and_dssr_allowance_model.description: Paste-ready compliance narratives, control specifications, or submission sections.

oconus_theater_deployment_overview.description: Executive determination overview, regulatory citations, and readiness score.

sofa_host_nation_accreditation_matrix.description: Structured line-by-line regulatory audit, classification, or quantitative schedule rows.

spot_loa_and_crc_deployment_checklist.description: Statutory governance protocol and actionable submission verification checklist.
